sections.directors_report: DIRECTORS' REPORT (CONTINUED) FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 APRIL 2025 - 4 - Intensity measurement The chosen intensity measurement ratio is total gross emissions in metric tonnes CO2e per full time employee, the recommended ratio for the sector. Measures taken to improve energy efficiency Bell Trucks (Holdings) Limited is committed to reducing its environmental impact and contribution to climate change through increased energy management and awareness, as well as improvements to operational procedures. In 2023 the business moved into a new purpose-built premises and benefits from energy efficient appliances. Unfortunately, and through no fault of Bell Trucks (Holdings) Limited, the business was unable to energise this premises via the grid until September 2025 and had to rely on the use of a generator which significantly increased our use of gas oil. Bell Trucks (Holdings) Limited continues to assess its processes throughout the business to reduce energy consumption and also looks at what can be done in any new premises they move into to make sure they are operational in the most energy efficient way. Statement of disclosure to auditor So far as each person who was a director at the date of approving this report is aware, there is no relevant audit information of which the auditor of the company is unaware. Additionally, the directors individually have taken all the necessary steps that they ought to have taken as directors in order to make themselves aware of all relevant audit information and to establish that the auditor of the company is aware of that information. sections.principal_risks: Principal risks and uncertainties The group is subject to a number of risks and uncertainties. These include the competitive environment in which the business operates, economic factors which influence customer behaviour and credit worthiness.The directors are aware of these risks and manage these accordingly. The group is also governed by a wide range of legislation and takes great care to keep up to date with all new legislation and regulations to ensure that it can maintain its position within the industry.
